verdict.rationale: Fern's pricing page lists both password-protected docs and visitor authentication via JWT and SSO, which covers all three gating methods named in the story. The evidence is only feature line items on the pricing page, with no configuration docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of per-page or per-section gating (some vs all docs), setup or configuration docs for password, JWT and SSO, which plan tier includes these features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
